node.title: PMA folded-source subsumption and low-defect raw-payment route cut
node.statement: If both a received word and listed codeword factor through x -> x^d, their full agreement set is K_d-periodic and the codeword is already exhausted by the global exact-periodic owner. Low-defect error supports admit a chart-free boundary-stripping predicate and reserve-preserving periodic multisequence reduction, but on the official sigma=1 grid the raw d=2, beta=1 candidate route is n*N/(N-h) times Q_2(k+2), strictly above the 719 Q_2 line. Therefore QCLOSE is empty in the current PMA route and every low-defect exact-stabilizer-one survivor remains in the direct GROW union RES theorem.
